(rule!
 ;; Each red(2) cell sits on the rim of a blob cluster. It fires AWAY
 ;; from the cluster: a red ray to the grid edge, flanked at every step
 ;; by green(3) wings as wide as the cluster's span on the launch axis.
 ;; The cluster box is grown by alternating row/column sweeps before
 ;; reading which rim the red cell occupies.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (grow start step good?)  ;; slide while the NEXT spot is good
       (let loop ((k start))
         (if (good? (+ k step)) (loop (+ k step)) k)))
     (define (launch out rr cc)
       (let* ((r1 (grow rr -1 (lambda (k) (and (>= k 0)
                                               (not (zero? (at g k cc)))))))
              (r2 (grow rr 1 (lambda (k) (and (< k h)
                                              (not (zero? (at g k cc)))))))
              (c1 (grow cc -1 (lambda (k) (and (>= k 0)
                                               (not (zero? (at g rr k)))))))
              (c2 (grow cc 1 (lambda (k) (and (< k w)
                                              (not (zero? (at g rr k)))))))
              (c1f (grow c1 -1
                         (lambda (k)
                           (and (>= k 0)
                                (any? (lambda (kr)
                                        (not (zero? (at g kr k))))
                                      (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))))
              (c2f (grow c2 1
                         (lambda (k)
                           (and (< k w)
                                (any? (lambda (kr)
                                        (not (zero? (at g kr k))))
                                      (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))))
              (r1f (grow r1 -1
                         (lambda (k)
                           (and (>= k 0)
                                (any? (lambda (kc)
                                        (not (zero? (at g k kc))))
                                      (range c1f (+ c2f 1)))))))
              (r2f (grow r2 1
                         (lambda (k)
                           (and (< k h)
                                (any? (lambda (kc)
                                        (not (zero? (at g k kc))))
                                      (range c1f (+ c2f 1)))))))
              (fdr (cond ((= rr r1f) -1) ((= rr r2f) 1) (else 0)))
              (fdc (cond ((= cc c1f) -1) ((= cc c2f) 1) (else 0)))
              (dr (if (zero? fdc) fdr 0))
              (dc (if (zero? fdr) fdc 0)))
         (if (and (zero? dr) (zero? dc))
             out
             (let ((half (cond ((= dc -1) (- c2f cc))
                               ((= dc 1) (- cc c1f))
                               ((= dr -1) (- r2f rr))
                               (else (- rr r1f)))))
               (let ext ((er (+ rr dr)) (ec (+ cc dc)) (acc out))
                 (if (not (in-bounds? er ec h w))
                     acc
                     (ext (+ er dr) (+ ec dc)
                          (for/fold ((a2 (set-cell acc er ec 2)))
                                    ((k (range 1 (+ half 1))))
                            (let* ((p1 (if (zero? dr)
                                           (list (- er k) ec)
                                           (list er (- ec k))))
                                   (p2 (if (zero? dr)
                                           (list (+ er k) ec)
                                           (list er (+ ec k))))
                                   (a3 (if (in-bounds? (first p1)
                                                       (second p1) h w)
                                           (set-cell a2 (first p1)
                                                     (second p1) 3)
                                           a2)))
                              (if (in-bounds? (first p2) (second p2)
                                              h w)
                                  (set-cell a3 (first p2) (second p2)
                                            3)
                                  a3))))))))))
